name: Jordana Andrade Santos
bio: Jordana Andrade Santos is a toxicologist with a PhD in Pharmaceutical Sciences from the Federal University of Goiás (UFG), Brazil. Her research covers alternatives to animal testing, including a research period on organ-on-chip systems at TissUse GmbH in Berlin.

items: MSc in Physiological Sciences, with a focus on reproductive toxicology (UFG)
Member of the Brazilian Society of Toxicology (SBTox)
Secretary of the Young Toxicologists Committee (CJTox/SBTox)
Articles in international journals and in the specialist press
PETA Science Consortium International: Award to Attend Training on In Vitro Lung Models (2023)
Selected in the Natura · IFSCC Scientific Call (2024)
Work presented at the 13th World Congress on Alternatives (2025)
Honorable mention at the 1st International Digital Congress on 3D Biofabrication
